title: Keep the reversible echo separate from useful recovery
statement: The two repeated controlled-SWAP cells restore both persistent physical carriers and an arbitrary entangled flag exactly at every r. Inserting an independent-junk replacement between them changes |+> flag visibility from 1 to 1/r² despite the unchanged maximally mixed junk marginal. This discriminates retained history from the spent-carrier architecture; it is not an inverse or a resource advantage.
